description: Dated shutdown early-warning commitment ledger: per forecast issue day, the SHA-256 of the forecast file and its comparison arms, or a missed day scored as zero alerts. No performance score yet; alerts and scores are not disclosed. A hash proves a later-released file matches the committed one, not when it was issued. Optional since (YYYY-MM-DD) returns rows dated on or after it.

since.description: Optional UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD; returns rows dated on or after it

name: get_early_warning_commitments
